Okay so now the keyboard has managed to someone get EVEN worse.

I'm on beta 1932, and the animations of the keyboard was added to this god awful thing. Why? Idk. I guess chat GPT wanted to throw flare in the UI.

None the less

****THE BUG:****

Pressing [ENTER] or [RIGHT SHIFT] will RESET the animation of the keyboard. Even while you're actively typing on it. This means the entire UI gets reset and you have to wait for the animation to finish to start typing again.

However, because the animation ALSO reset, it will also NOT capitalize anything because the animation has reset the action of the shift key being pressed.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
